question: Which feature is supported with an In-Service Software Upgrade on a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series switch?
options: upgrades to individual modules and line cards
zero downtime downgrades via dual supervisor modules
theory: Nexus 9000 ISSU relies on dual supervisors and nonstop forwarding (NSF): while the standby supervisor is upgraded and a switchover occurs, the data plane on line cards keeps forwarding traffic using existing forwarding state, so the upgrade completes without a full reload. Configuration changes are not permitted mid-upgrade, individual line cards aren't upgraded independently of the coordinated ISSU sequence, and downgrades follow the same disruptive/nondisruptive rules as upgrades rather than being inherently zero-downtime. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — In-Service Software Upgrade)
